title: AC1024 associative radius/diameter-constraint node
scope: Decode the witnessed AC1024 version-0 inline AcRadiusDiameterConstraint body and its two dependency handles while preserving incomplete groups and strict document-level refusal.

independentLayoutSource.layout: read_explicit_constraint reads owner ID (BL), implied (B), active only outside legacy/version-0, then value-dependency and dimension-dependency handles. The RadiusDiameter branch then reads mode as a raw byte (RC).

autodesk.result: The same-input mode value 1 denotes kCircleDiameter. Autodesk describes the node as applicable to a circle/arc or bounded ellipse; this does not qualify rendered dimension behavior.

sections: Section 2, page 7: BL, RC and H primitive identities; RC is a raw, uncompressed character.
Section 2.13, pages 15–16: code 5 is a hard-pointer reference and both endpoints remain owned elsewhere.
odaSpecification.result: The ODA specification defines the primitive and handle-role encodings; the pinned peer source supplies this class's field order and the same-input trace supplies the observed profile.

localRawProbe.method: At the unknown-class boundary, fork the node body and handle streams, read the pinned-source sequence transactionally, and log results without committing either probe position.

independentTargetInspection.limitation: LibreDWG independently confirms the target records and the dimension-dependency body owner; it does not decode this constraint-node body or establish consumer meaning.

implementedTrace.result: The implemented branch decodes mode 1 and handles 1363/1364, then continues through the source sequence to AcConstrainedDatumLine node 412 before strict export refusal.

limitations: This receipt covers the observed AC1024 version-0 inline profile and the four documented mode values only.
Null, wrong-role and other-version dependency forms remain raw until independently witnessed.
The constraint group remains incomplete; associative output, readback, rendered dimensions and consumer meaning are unqualified. This receipt has no support-claim effect.

fields: DataKind::RadiusDiameter, owner ID, implied flag, absent active flag, two hard-pointer dependency handles and raw mode byte.
The decoder commits the forked body/handle streams only when both non-null handle roles and the complete documented mode byte fit the bounded record.
implementation.failureBehavior: Wrong value/dimension handle roles, modes outside 0–3 and a missing mode byte leave the node untyped/raw, preserve a partial group, and recover the following OBJECT.
generatedControls: From-scratch profiles cover all four documented mode bytes and exact fields/handle roles.
A following implicit-point node retains its exact fields and soft-pointer dependency, proving both Radius/Diameter handles were consumed in order.
Separate controls reject a wrong value role, wrong dimension role, undocumented mode and missing mode byte while preserving the raw carrier and following-OBJECT recovery.
